data.title: Enara
data.about:
Enara by Omniyat is a state-of-the-art, 21-floor commercial building strategically located along the Marasi Drive waterfront. Designed with businesses in mind, Enara offers a sophisticated and modern workspace that seamlessly combines luxury and functionality. The building features spacious office layouts, landscaped terraces, and direct lift access for added convenience. Enara’s eco-friendly design ensures a sustainable working environment, while its prime location provides businesses with direct access to the vibrant commercial hub of Dubai.

In addition to its sleek and functional office spaces, Enara Tower at Business Bay by Omniyat offers a range of hotel-like amenities that enhance the work-life balance for its tenants. The building includes ground-floor lobbies, three basement-level parking, and a host of modern conveniences like a Michelin-star restaurant on-site. Whether you’re looking for a sustainable, high-end workspace or a prestigious waterfront address, Enara by Omniyat offers the ideal commercial setting for forward-thinking businesses in Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: Luxury Commercial Spaces with Exclusive Amenities
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exclusive Private Members' Club: Enara in Business Bay has a Private Members' Club on Levels 1 and 4 that offers an exclusive space for networking and business meetings.
  • Efficient Office Lifts: 12 office lifts, including 3 shuttle lifts, provide fast and convenient access across all floors.
  • Nature-Integrated Workspaces: Landscaped terraces for each office offer direct access to nature, enhancing the work environment.
  • Flexible Office Spaces: Offices can be expanded into stunning duplex and triplex layouts by opening staircases and voids.
  • Grand Office Spaces with Support Facilities: Spacious offices come with dedicated support spaces and meeting rooms, ideal for business needs.

location_tile.title: Prime Business Hub: Enara by Omniyat Location in Business Bay
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Enara by Omniyat is ideally situated in Business Bay, one of Dubai’s most vibrant and sought-after business districts. This thriving area is known for its dynamic mix of commercial, residential, and leisure developments, making it a key destination for professionals and entrepreneurs.

Positioned along Marasi Drive, the building enjoys proximity to iconic landmarks such as the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall. It offers easy access to major roads like Sheikh Zayed Road, ensuring seamless connectivity across the city. With world-class dining, entertainment, and shopping just minutes away, Enara’s prime location offers businesses the perfect blend of convenience, prestige, and modern urban living.

  • Sheikh Zayed Road – 5 minutes
  • Business Bay Metro Station – 5 minutes
  • Dubai Mall – 7 minutes
  • Downtown Dubai – 8 minutes
  • Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) – 10 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport (DXB) – 15 minutes

seo.metaTitle: Enara Tower at Business Bay by Omniyat
seo.metaDescription: Discover Enara at Business Bay by Omniyat, a luxury commercial building offering spacious office units and retail spaces in the commercial hub of Dubai.

more_info.answer: Enara provides flexible office spaces, including options to create duplex and triplex layouts by opening staircases and voids, making it ideal for growing businesses.
more_info.question: What type of offices does Enara offer?

more_info.answer: Enara offers a range of amenities, including an exclusive Private Members' Club, landscaped terraces, 12 office lifts (including 3 shuttle lifts), hotel-like services, and five levels of parking.
more_info.question: What amenities are available at Enara?

more_info.answer: The handover for Enara by Omniyat is expected to take place in 2028.
more_info.question: When is the handover for Enara?

more_info.answer: Enara offers a flexible payment plan of 70/30, allowing buyers to pay 70% during construction and the remaining 30% upon handover.
